cc:Work.dc:description: Policy upgrade. The required spacing falls from 3617.5 to 1367.5 m, so the follower must run faster than the leader for a while. The baseline commands exactly zero for the entire run and the gap never moves: its command is min(free-flow, following), the free-flow term k_speed(cruise - v) is exactly zero at cruise, and the positive following term of +11.25 m/s2 is discarded by the minimum. This is structural, not a gain that needs tuning. The reference makes the deliberate excursion the manoeuvre requires, peaking at 80 m/s, and lands on the target exactly.
